nodes.what: People who buy books on the site.
nodes.how: They use the storefront in a browser.

nodes.label: Storefront
nodes.when: Whenever a shopper browses or checks out.
nodes.how: A static build served by the edge proxy; it calls the Shop API.

nodes.label: Edge proxy
nodes.how: Serves the storefront and forwards /api to the Shop API.

nodes.label: Shop API
nodes.how: Reads and writes the database; puts paid orders on the order queue.

nodes.label: Accounts and sign-in
nodes.how: Part of the Shop API; keeps hashed passwords and session tokens.

nodes.label: Order queue
nodes.how: A table the worker claims from.

nodes.label: Order worker
nodes.how: Claims an order, books the delivery and sends the confirmation.

nodes.label: Payment provider
nodes.how: The Shop API redirects to it and reads the result.

nodes.label: Hosts
nodes.how: One server for the web tier, one for the database.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.how: A merge to main builds the image and deploys it to the hosts.

nodes.label: Dashboards
nodes.what: Metrics and logs in one place.
nodes.how: Would read the API's and worker's metrics.
